youtube.title: THE WILMS REPORT
youtube.summary: In this fortnightly catch up with Paul Brennan, Tim Wilms examines the Victorian election campaign, including the debate over One Nation’s place in leaders’ forums, competing spending promises and proposed restrictions on political slogans. He also discusses the Melbourne anti-mass-migration rally, Jacinda Ardern’s new university role, an apology over COVID-19 vaccinations given to teenagers without informed consent, the attack on independent MP Helen Haines and a landmark murder sentencing appeal. Discover more from Tim at The Unshackled

He also challenges the fairness of taxpayer-funded media coverage, raises concerns about election integrity and genetic technology, and outlines his views on healthcare, chronic disease prevention and the economic choices facing New Zealand.
